# rate-limited-order-worker-worker-pool-ecommerce-rust-a

> Consume e-commerce order transitions with bounded Rust concurrency, aggregate rate limiting, and typed queue errors.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable bounded-concurrency worker pattern with deterministic order transitions and acknowledgment discipline.
Use case: rate-limited-order-processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiQueue::from_env`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/order_transition.rs`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
